description: Pass the receipt from any code_* answer and learn whether this service issued it and it is unchanged. Answers {verified, reason, id}: verified true or false; reason null, or one of bad_shape (not a receipt, or malformed), unknown_block (an id@version these tools do not answer), not_ours (not issued by this service), altered (changed after it was issued), unavailable (cannot be checked right now; retry later) or self_check_failed; id is the receipt id. With no input, runs the code tools' self-check and answers verified true or false. Read-only.

receipt.description: The receipt from a code_* answer (its structuredContent.receipt, or the JSON after "receipt: "); an object with a receipt key is unwrapped once. Omit it to run the self-check.

name: library_verify
title: Check a code answer's receipt
